messages.text: Shop····  I sent a couple emails about a miner I received that is not performing like it should.  I have had no respone

Sorry about the silence, that's not how this should go. Let me pull the order up: what's the email address on Shop····? Once I have it I'll look at the unit and what's been logged, and we'll sort the performance issue from there.
(email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill

Got it, the KBOX (22 TH/s) was delivered September 23. Sorry no one came back to you on those emails.

Most common cause of a KBOX running under 22 TH/s is the power supply sagging under load, the fan and screen run fine but the hashboard drops sticks once it pulls full power. What's it actually reporting, and is that the reading on the miner or at your pool?

I've pinged JD on our hardware side so he's on this with you here.
Handed to the team · Hardware underperformance on a delivered unit, plus two unanswered emails; needs
Stay in the chat if you can, someone will jump in here with you. If you step away, the answer comes to your email.
The unit is advertised at approximately 11 TH/s in Low mode and 17 TH/s in Medium mode. Mine produced approximately 7 TH/s in Low and only 9–10 TH/s in Medium.

That's well short on both modes, not a tuning gap. Sounds like sticks dropping out or a PSU that can't hold load.

One thing I have to ask up front: was it ever overclocked or modified? Overclocked units aren't covered for RMA or replacement.

If it's stock, start the return here and you'll get a label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Processing is up to 10 days once the unit lands at the warehouse. JD's on this chat too.
and only 12 of 18 Chips are working

Six dead chips settles it, that's a faulty unit, not your setup. Nothing you can tune will bring those back.

Put it through the RMA form and you'll get a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Add the order number, the chip count and those hashrate readings, it speeds things up. Processing is up to 10 days once it reaches the warehouse.

Just confirm for me it was running stock, never overclocked, and JD can push this along from his side.
I never overclocked

Good, then you're covered. Fill in the RMA form and the label comes back to you, it's the only intake so nothing else is needed from your side.

I've noted on your file that it ran stock and that 12 of 18 chips are live, so JD has it in front of him here. The exact warranty terms for the KBOX are being confirmed, I won't quote you a number I'm not sure of.

Anything else on the unit while you're here?
where is the ram form

Here it is: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Open it, put in order Shop····, your address and what the unit is doing (7 TH/s low, 9 to 10 medium, 12 of 18 chips live). Submit it and the return label comes back to you by email.

If the form won't load for you, tell me and I'll get it sorted from this side.
it will not let me copy from this chat

Just tap the link, it's clickable in the chat, no copying needed. On desktop, click it and it opens in a new tab.

If it won't open at all, a full copy of this conversation, link included, goes to (email hidden) once we're done here, so you can open it from there.

Want me to have the team send the RMA link straight to your inbox now instead?
